observations: The page number «54» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it; a short oblique stroke beside the right end of the rule, not transcribed. The page has no signature. L01-L07 end chapter 10, after the two computations of the place of Saturn on pp. 52-53 (JP2 0084-0085). L08-L09: the heading of chapter 11, in bold, centred, with the reference to the text below it.
L01-L07: «c. 11°», «c. 10°»: the two true longitudes of p. 53 (JP2 0085) differ by 11° 38′, and the two mean longitudes by 9° 40′; the «c. 43′» of L07 is Suter's own computation, which is not given.

N01: the quotation is the sentence of chapter 11 of the Latin text, p. 12 (JP2 0044, L03-L04), «excepto quod eorum in libro scriptum est argumentum atque eorundem et solis unum idemque est elwacat», with «elwacat» there in italics; here the whole quotation is in italics.

L20-L32: the computation, set as tables: in L20-L26 the figures stand in a column at the right, the names of L21-L23 and L26 joined to them by dotted leaders, which are not transcribed, the ditto marks „ of L22-L23 under «Zunahme» and «in»; L24, «Summa :», stands below a rule under the figures of L23, and L26 below a rule under «— 360°» (the minus 22 px, set 15 px before the figures); L26 alone has «=». L27-L29: the figures after a column of «=», L27 and L29 with dotted leaders, L29 below a rule. L30-L32: two computations side by side, each with its names, leaders and figures, L32 below rules under the figures of both. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed.

L20-L35. Checked: 232° 45′ + 216° 15′ + 18° 30′ + 8° 38′ = 476° 8′, less 360° 116° 8′; with Brahmagupta's parameters (7 022 389 492 revolutions of the conjunction of Venus and 4 320 000 000 of the sun in 1 577 916 450 000 days, see p. 42, JP2 0074) the anomaly of Venus moves 216° 15′ 26″ in the 29 years, 10277 days, 18° 29′ 47″ in thirty days and 8° 37′ 54″ in fourteen days. 131° 1′ − 59° 9′ = 71° 52′; 71° 52′ − 2° 7′ = 69° 45′; 116° 8′ + 2° 7′ = 118° 15′; 69° 45′ + 44° 43½′ = 114° 28½′. The values of Tables 15-16, 47 and 48 are to be compared with the tables.

L34: «44° 43½′», «114° 28½′», the fraction set with a raised 1 and a lowered 2; «Examinatio elheza» upright. L27: «131° 1′», the mean longitude of the sun of p. 42 rounded, as on p. 53 (JP2 0085, N01).

N04: «243–244»: a dash of 28 px with a gap of 11 px before it and 7 px after it, like «45–46» on p. 42 (JP2 0074, N06); transcribed as an en dash. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Kh.», «Nallino»; italics: «Bestimmung des wahren Ortes der Venus», the Latin of N01-N02.
The colons and the semicolon stand after the thin space of the edition (10-13 px measured).
